mentions.name: AI-Coded Proc-Gen Browser Extension
mentions.description: A browser extension built entirely through hands-off AI coding with Claude Code, featuring procedural-generation type functionality; it is a side project used as a distraction from the author's main game engine work.
mentions.source_excerpt: A pure slop-crafted browser extension, because I paid for claude code Fable and it got rug-pulled so I am burning my tokens on a 100% slop project just to see what hands-off coding is actually like. A slight distraction from project 1 I do when I'm feeling a bit burnt out. Super fun so far proc-gen type stuff.
